title: Đàn ống xa
about: Round x3 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked for many more versions ("tôi rất thích các phiên bản bạn tạo, hãy tạo thêm cho tôi nhiều phiên bản khác"): a pipe organ far off in a stone church, soft, its chords moving slowly; a great bell tolling, the far choir joining in the middle. D minor at 44 bpm, the plagal G minor and the Phrygian E flat. An original piece.
